raw_result: {"facts": [{"item_id": "c3ce64e9d3fc497e8fe7d680a15d59ab::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "An absent value *MAY* indicate that the resource has never changed after its initial publication, or that the date of last modification is not known, or that the resource is continuously updated."}, {"item_id": "502d8210e35f4914b4fe96a8a9338f84::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Property describing changes between a resource version and its predecessor."}, {"item_id": "20d345e650df45b3a4e8bc5fde134192::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "The activity that generates test assertions and results over a dataset."}, {"item_id": "6a020f6b801f49189ad0ce41d9432048::verbatim_text", "attribute": "verbatim_text", "fact_text": "can be used to specify a version hierarchy, by linking an abstract resource to its versions"}, {"item_id": "adb0eb0ac8084cd58a39b695d9b0efcc::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "DCAT 3 defines `dcat:theme` as an OWL object property."}, {"item_id": "adb0eb0ac8084cd58a39b695d9b0efcc::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "DCAT 3 drops the range of `dcat:theme` to make the formalization of the property more consistent with the expected use."}, {"item_id": "49f62c6ebb2942c2940803b1f052b653::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Properly identify and document suppressed data (e.g., in very small counties)"}, {"item_id": "0bf4d81f979e471188bc7fab30ddd0c9::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "As per [GeoSPARQL], when the CRS specification is omitted this implies that the default CRS is used - namely CRS84."}, {"item_id": "0bf4d81f979e471188bc7fab30ddd0c9::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "CRS84 corresponds to WGS84, but with axis order longitude/latitude."}, {"item_id": "7ee0e550b50346469ed2b2801083238e::verbatim_text", "attribute": "verbatim_text", "fact_text": "Data citation is the practice of referencing data in a similar way as when providing bibliographic references"}, {"item_id": "7ee0e550b50346469ed2b2801083238e::verbatim_text", "attribute": "verbatim_text", "fact_text": "Data citation acknowledges data as a first class output in any investigative process"}]}
